notes: The braking light is three colours: green when you are doing it well, amber for mid, red when it needs work, and nothing else - even when you beat your own reference. Braking later than your reference, or taking a braking corner flat and coming out level or quicker, now reads green rather than purple; it was the one light on the panel that could show a fourth colour, which read as confusing rather than as praise. A corner your reference takes flat is green when you take it flat, amber for a dab and red for real braking. The gas light can still show purple. Also in this build, from 0.9.158 to 0.9.160: field events are never about your own car and are no longer logged twice; brake-point drill results reach the leaderboard again; your desktop can no longer end up in a highlight clip; SMART remembers the brake bias you actually ran, read live from the car since it is saved into no setup file; the finished video is named and opened from the Highlights panel and named by when it was made; the Stint and Corners windows show the turns that fit with the one you are approaching in the middle; the Stint and Drill panels scale their text; the radar redraws at 33 ms; iRacing qualifying no longer calls cars closing behind you; and the chequered flag waits until you cross the line.
